message.value: "A prompt is not just a question — it is the text you give the model that sets what to do, who it is for, and what shape the answer takes, before the model writes anything." (Essence, ≤8 words: 'A prompt is direction-setting text you give.') Viewer restatement target: 'The prompt is the steering text. Vague in, generic out.' — with the L6 addition: 'A prompt is just this once — instructions are the rules standing behind every chat.'
message.rationale: The one learning sentence (T-17), unchanged from script i1 through the locked i3; the board's T-17 check passes on the closing definition (L8) as the piece's single landing.

story_structure.value: And–But–Therefore (clarity), as a misconception-correction arc (S-11). AND: you type text and the same model answers — two very different answers (L1). BUT: the difference is not luck; it is the prompt, whose three jobs are counted on screen (L2–L3) and performed as a vague-vs-directed pair (L4–L5). THEREFORE: the prompt is steering text — placed against standing Instructions (L6), the folk fix dies (L7), and the close restates the definition (L8). Intended feeling: a small click of control — 'the answer was in my hands before the model wrote a word.'
story_structure.rationale: Declared before drafting in the i1 Narrative Gate (N-04) and re-verified in the locked i3's HS-09 consistency record: structure = misconception-correction arc, chosen because the viewer's existing model ('a prompt is just a question') is the thing being replaced.

prompt_instructions_canon.source: board ask req-wd02-prompt-canon (Action #27) — open; the embodied ruling is PROVISIONAL in the script of record
prompt_instructions_canon.record: THE PROPOSED RULING, embodied in the built piece (script v3 §0 + scene record DR-RULING): 'prompt' is not a system part and not a rival term to Instructions — a prompt is the text given in the moment, one call's worth of input, part of the active context; Instructions are the standing guidance stored in the harness that steers every call. It lives in the piece at L6: 'A prompt lives once, in this chat. Instructions are the rules you set once, standing behind every chat.' Status in the script of record: PROVISIONAL — derived by exhaustion search of Hadi's own library (The Language of Agents; We Could Have Had AGI By Now; LLMs Are Not the Agents; canon §3 — full trail in script v3 §0), shipped inside the artifact for Hadi to correct on it under his substantial-artifact rule; the bare gates #27/#28 were withdrawn (sprint plan F-3) and the board's extra_check 'Canon call: prompt is not a canon term' stands pending. If he rules otherwise, L6 is the only line that moves. Record discrepancy, carried not smoothed: the governing ask's context quotes v2-era lines (its L6/L8 are the superseded i2 mechanism/close lines) — the ask predates the unfreeze round; the proposal of record is the built v3 L6 above.
